html:
SMTO-UI-0005 — You can attach at most 16 items to one message

GUID: 73c4a133-ec2f-4508-8ddb-fe267aca4d65
Slug: ui-context-source-limit
Domain: UI · Subsystem: ui

What happened

  • One message can include up to 16 attached files or context items. You've reached that limit, so the new item wasn't added. Items already attached stay attached.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Remove items you don't need: select the × on an attached item (its tooltip says Remove from next request) to take it off this message. Each item you remove frees a space for one you do need.
  2. Or send this message with the items you have, then attach the rest to your next message. The limit is per message, so splitting the work lets you use more files overall.
  3. If you have many small text files, combine them into one document before attaching it. One combined file uses one space instead of many.

What success looks like

  • The item you want appears among the attachments and the message sends.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. This limit can't be changed in Settings, so plan to split the work across messages.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A context selection was refused because the message already holds, or would exceed, 16 context references (the browser's remaining-slot check and the server's max_attachments limit).

What this means

  • The client has no remaining context slots, or the server receives more than 16 context references. The shown control rejects this local action before its dependent submission. Earlier requests and saved state are unaffected by this validation result; server-side authority remains authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • The client has no remaining context slots, or the server receives more than 16 context references.

How to diagnose it

  • Count current context references and pending selections against the 16-source bound.

How to fix it

  • The composer's remaining-slot check and the mobile context picker refuse any selection beyond 16 references, matching max_attachments=16 from /api/agent/context/limits; this limit is fixed, not a setting. Remove unneeded references or split the work across messages; don't bypass scope or ownership checks to force more sources into one request.
  • Reduce or split the selected sources before submitting the task.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • The task is submitted with at most 16 deliberate sources.

What not to do

  • Do not bypass scope or ownership checks to force a larger operation through.

Technical notes

  • The shown control rejects this local action before its dependent submission. Earlier requests and saved state are unaffected by this validation result; server-side authority remains authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
